issue.title: Retire plugin_catalog_scoped_latest
issue.description: Eager PyPI latest-version enrichment is limited to installed plugins. The Updates > Plugins highlighted row lazily fetches latest for the current uninstalled entry through the detail debouncer. sase plugin show still fetches the requested plugin. sase plugin list stays installed-only unless -A|--all-latest.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The scoped path has soaked and phase guard has either flipped this flag on by default or deleted the full-eager branch.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Every catalog entry is eagerly enriched from PyPI, including uninstalled plugins (the pre-scale per-entry network storm).
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Eager PyPI latest-version enrichment is limited to installed plugins. The Updates > Plugins highlighted row lazily fetches latest for the current uninstalled entry through the detail debouncer. sase plugin show still fetches the requested plugin. sase plugin list stays installed-only unless -A|--all-latest.

payload.entry: LANDING RECONCILIATION (epic sase-qn, 2026-08-19): the flag stays kind=beta / default off, and this is a recorded decision, not an oversight. The scoped O(installed) eager-enrichment path and the lazy highlighted-row fetch are fully implemented and tested in both states; tests/perf/check_plugin_catalog_scale_regression.py enforces the scoped curve (fetch_calls = installed_count = 5 at n=1000 and n=2000, and a linear enrich scan_work ceiling) through 'just plugin-catalog-scale-check' and the CI perf-floors job. Phase sase-qn.5 proposed converting beta -> sunset so scoped enrichment would be default-on; the land agent verified that is not currently possible: 'sase bead update' exposes only -b/--remove-by for a flag bead (no kind mutation), the registry-derived default is not independently settable, and flipping only the registry would fail sase.feature_flags.integrity with code=kind_mismatch. No separate task bead was filed for that conversion because this bead already owns the outcome: FlagTriage's Remove branch (delete the Off branch, make the On branch unconditional) achieves default-on scoped enrichment directly, which is the same end state. Until then the default remains the pre-scale full-eager path, so a 1000+ entry catalog still issues one PyPI probe per uninstalled entry unless a user opts in.
